description.p: Video Harness is a native workspace for prompting, reviewing, monitoring, downloading, and playing AI video generations from multiple providers.
It keeps provider credentials separate, confirms the latest price before every paid request, and makes reference media compatibility explicit.
Adds a responsive interface, truthful generated-audio controls, Tiny Cloud Cinema job feedback, and multi-architecture Flatpak distribution.
Adds typed image, video, and audio inputs with model-aware validation.
Completes the move to a focused native GTK application.
Introduces the native GTK interface, local reference staging, and concurrent job monitoring.
